messages.subject: International Statistical Ecology Conference:  bursaries for
parts:
International Statistical Ecology Conference, St Andrews, UK, July 9-11,
2008

Royal Statistical Society bursaries for attendees from developing countries


Two bursaries are available for attendees from developing countries.
These bursaries, each worth 400 pounds, will cover registration and
accommodation costs, but not travel. If you would like to apply for one
of these bursaries, please e-mail rh...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk by 31st January
2008. You should state in no more than 300 words your reasons for
wanting to attend.

We define developing countries to be any country on one of the following
UN lists: Least Developed Countries; Landlocked Developing
Countries; Small Island Developing States; Transition Countries (see
http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49regin.htm).
